title: Meet the woman behind chart-topping AI artist Xania Monet (CBS News)
notes: CBS News (Gayle King), 2025-11-05. Telisha 'Nikki' Jones (31, Mississippi, Black woman) created Xania Monet; 'Xania is an extension of me.' Not a singer; lyrics 100% her own (poems). Suno prompts: 'female soulful vocals, slow tempo R&B.' Digital-blackface concern raised; Jones: 'I'm a Black woman... I created Xania.' $multi-million Hallwood deal; Kehlani backlash.
